Local lane only: agent_executor.py:2752-2775 polls .agents/delegation/control/<task_id>.jsonl via control_channel.poll between turns, and only local-agent tasks run that loop. Writers: aq-agent-send (via aq-subagent-interactive) and the dashboard POST /loop/control steer and POST /agent-runs/{run_id}/guidance routes, which enqueue only for an ACTIVE local-agent task and otherwise answer unsupported (never delivered). aq-human-intervention was archived (.agent/archive/20261127-aq-human-intervention): it had no production caller, and of its kinds only inject and cancel were read by the consumer (pause, resume, skip and edit_intent were queued but treated as plain text). live_caller is the real consumer, which references control_channel, not the entrypoint name. Owner-accepted design 2026-11-27 after Codex and Gemini review.

deferral.reason: No steering path exists for non-local lanes: their CLIs read no control queue, so the dashboard returns unsupported (HTTP 422 on /loop/control, delivery_status unsupported on the guidance route) instead of claiming delivery. Owner-accepted 2026-11-27: honest status text now, GUI rework later.
deferral.acceptance: A design is accepted and implemented for one non-local lane such that (1) a steer sent to an active task on that lane is read by that lane's runner and changes its next step, (2) the dashboard reports delivered only after a consumer acknowledgement is recorded, not at enqueue time, (3) _resolve_steerable_task refusals shrink accordingly and test-steering-honest-delivery.py gains a per-lane delivery case, and (4) a live end-to-end steer on that lane is attested.
